notes.title: MOVER Update 2018.11.24
notes.content:
Hi,guys. recently updated v0.24 version.

and added 'Cloud Archiver' function.

This version update is as follows:

1. Added Cloud Archiver function.
2. Officially support full joystick control.
3. Added player died sfx, button sfx.


[b]Ps:your old archive maybe missing, because cloud archiver will overlay that.[/b]

tags.feature: 3. Added player died sfx, button sfx.

notes.title: MOVER Update 2018.09.27
notes.content:
Hi,all.Recently I finally got idle, so I started the modification of the mover.

Current version is 0.2.

This version update is as follows:

1. Added Select Level function.
2. Added option menu.
3. Loading level will no longer wait a long time.
4. Achievements can't pop up bug fixes.
5. Bullets are added to static batch optimization.
6. New OBB physical system no longer uses unity.
7. New UI.



If has any question you can follow my twitter:
https://twitter.com/hont127

or send to steamcommunity, Thanks!

tags.feature: 3. Loading level will no longer wait a long time.

tags.bug: 4. Achievements can't pop up bug fixes.

tags.feature: 5. Bullets are added to static batch optimization.
6. New OBB physical system no longer uses unity.

notes.title: Update 11.21
notes.content:
Hi,there. Recent i made the few minor changes.


1.Remove multi-language support outside English (for better gaming quality in the future).

2.Temporarily remove the game exit panel, you can Alt + F4 exit the game.


There will be some functional changes in the future, but probably wait a few months.
